name: learning-monorepo

scripts.build: pnpm run check:workspace && pnpm run clean && pnpm -r run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build && pnpm -r run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm run build && pnpm run test:built
scripts.check: pnpm run build && pnpm -r run typecheck && pnpm run test:built
scripts.demo: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter @demo/planner start && pnpm --filter @demo/report start

description: pnpm workspace + TypeScript monorepo tutorial with shared packages, dependency boundaries, topological builds and CI. 从零搭建多包仓库的架构教学 Demo。
